Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Are you passionate about building reliable automation solutions for products that make an impact in healthcare? We are seeking a Senior Test Automation Engineer with extensive experience in designing and implementing automated quality assurance strategies across desktop, web, and backend systems. This role focuses on developing scalable automation frameworks, validating application performance, integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines, and driving continuous quality improvement.
 At Sigma Software, we offer the flexibility of working in a collaborative international environment, access to challenging technical projects, and opportunities for continuous professional growth. Why join us? You will help improve the quality and reliability of healthcare solutions, where stability and precision truly matter. 
 CUSTOMER 
 Our client is a company operating in the healthcare/medical industry that specializes in developing desktop software solutions. The company builds large-scale desktop systems used in medical environments, with a strong focus on software quality, reliability, and stability. 
 Job Description
Design, implement, and maintain scalable end-to-end test automation strategies
Implement and maintain test automation frameworks 
Build and optimize CI/CD quality gates and automated validation pipelines
Perform stress, load, and performance testing activities 
Collaborate closely with developers, architects, and QA engineers to improve product quality and reliability
Introduce and leverage AI-assisted testing and automation approaches where applicable
Analyze test results, identify bottlenecks, and drive continuous quality improvements
 Qualifications
5+ years of hands-on experience in test automation engineering
Strong expertise across multiple testing layers, including unit, integration, system, UI, performance, and stress testing
Strong programming skills in at least one of the following languages: JavaScript/TypeScript or Python
Practical experience with modern automation tools such as Playwright, Cypress
Experience using AI-assisted development and testing tools
Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and version control systems
Hands-on experience with GitLab CI or similar CI/CD platforms
Strong understanding of software quality assurance methodologies and automation best practices
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills
Upper-Intermediate English level or higher
 WILL BE A PLUS
Experience with Java or C#
Experience with Ranorex
Experience with penetration testing
Experience working in regulated industries
German language proficiency
